scripts.title: OP bendy disco (EQUIP PAINT TOOL)
scripts.features: makes the map disco (YOU NEED TO EQUIP THE PAINT TOOL FOR IT TO WORK) there is NO GUI so dont say it dosent work. I tested it on real but im pretty sure it works on all executors
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local AnchorParts = workspace:WaitForChild("anchorparts")

local Baseplate = AnchorParts:WaitForChild("Baseplate")
local Basecharcha1 = AnchorParts:WaitForChild("Basecharcha1")

local Speed = 0.12
local Hue = 0

local function getPaintEvent()
    local Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

    local Tool = Character:FindFirstChild("Tarrodepintura")
        or Player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Tarrodepintura")

    if not Tool then
        Tool = Character:WaitForChild("Tarrodepintura", 10)
    end

    if Tool then
        return Tool:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("ServerControls")
    end
end

local Event = getPaintEvent()

if not Event then
    warn("Equip paint tool.")
    return
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    
    Hue = (Hue + dt * Speed) % 1

    local RainbowColor = Color3.fromHSV(Hue, 1, 1)

    
    pcall(function()
        Event:InvokeServer("PaintPart", {
            Part = Baseplate,
            Color = RainbowColor
        })
    end)

    pcall(function()
        Event:InvokeServer("PaintPart", {
            Part = Basecharcha1,
            Color = RainbowColor
        })
    end)
end)
